links.outcome: AI chatbot accuracy and clinical relevance score versus pathology faculty and residents on same questions
links.effect: Faculty 4.75, chatbot 4.10, research-prepared residents 3.50, unprepared residents 2.87; chatbot significantly better than unprepared residents (P=.03), not different from faculty (P=.30).
links.quote: The AI chatbot scored statistically significantly better than unprepared residents (P = .03) but not statistically significantly different from research-prepared residents (P = .33) or faculty (P = .30).

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and clinical relevance of ChatGPT compared to pathology faculty and residents on clinical questions from a genitourinary tumor board without testing specific deployment practices.
